newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end flat after see-saw session.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end flat after see-saw session.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended flat on Wednesday after another fairly volatile session, with traders expecting no clear trend to be established until doubts overhanging key issues are resolved, dealers said.
The market is seen cautious ahead of U.S. May employment data, due on Friday, as well as indications from France and Germany of how and when European monetary union will go ahead.
The general index added 0.80 points, 0.14 percent, to 557.47 and the Ibex-35 rose 6.59 points, 0.1 percent, to 6,411.40.
Telefonica ended flat at 4,215 in heavy trade, but was seen more impervious to volatility than other stocks, dealers said.
"The whole day there's been no clear trend and there's the impression that it's going to be like that for a few days," said a dealer.

But others said the bourse could well turn sharply lower again, with all eyes on Friday's U.S. data --key to the Fed's next interest rate decision-- and amid uncertainty over the future of the European single currency, although medium term a bull trend remained intact in Spain.
"I think we could well see a big correction before we climb higher again," said one trader.
